subject.title: feat(wizard): deliver progress over the RPC wizard protocol

question: Should `progress` steps over the wizard RPC remain compatible with existing clients that answer every returned step, or should OpenClaw intentionally require clients to re-poll without an answer?
rationale: This changes a client-visible gateway protocol behavior, and current bundled clients still answer progress steps, so the permanent compatibility contract needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Preserve progress-answering clients
options.body: Make progress answers harmless server-side or update all bundled clients before emitting progress broadly.

options.title: Accept the contract break
options.body: Require all clients to re-poll without answering progress, but land it only with explicit rollout proof and documentation.

options.title: Pause for umbrella design
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader wizard RPC parity issue settles progress, auth challenge, and client behavior together.

recommendation.title: Preserve progress-answering clients
recommendation.body: Make progress answers harmless server-side or update all bundled clients before emitting progress broadly.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant history shows broad ownership across wizard session, gateway methods, Crestodian onboarding, and macOS onboarding clients.
